### New to stdpopsim?

If this is your first contribution, welcome! Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/popsim-consortium/stdpopsim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before making your first contribution. You do not need to be an established member of the stdpopsim community to contribute. However, by contributing you become a member of our community. The best way to introduce yourself to our community is to open or comment on an issue that describes what you plan to work on, before you open a pull request. If you open a pull request without having been in touch, a maintainer will reach out to you via GitHub, because we like to get to know the people who contribute.

Pull requests from people with no intention of becoming part of the stdpopsim community will not be accepted, including pull requests generated and submitted autonomously by AI agents.
